Subject: POC runbook & model selection for Stellaris Health

Hi Elena / Jared — thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can get the POC scheduled next week.

Call recap (2 min):
- Goal: Validate Redwood inference for clinical triage assistant workflows (routing, summarization, and multi-turn clarifications).
- Primary input language: English; must also support Spanish for ~25% of traffic.
- Data constraints: no PHI during trial (synthetic/hashed data), SOC2 controls required.

Proposed POC success criteria (suggested):
1) Intent/route accuracy >= 92% on the evaluation set (weighted by volume).
2) Mean latency (99th pctl) < 600 ms for 512-token context under expected concurrency.
3) Summarization fidelity: majority vote quality >= 4/5 from clinical SMEs on sample set.
4) Clear regression guardrails + monitoring integrated into Redwood Console.

Evaluation plan (high level):
- Week 0: Align on datasets and success criteria (this email).
- Week 1: Redwood spins up trial deployment, seeds test prompts, and shares access.
- Week 2: Joint evaluation (50–100 prompts in English, 25–50 in Spanish).
- Week 3: Final review, go/no-go decision and next steps for Dedicated.

Model selection (initial recommendation):
- Primary: Mistral-Instruct-2 (good instruction-following, strong multilingual base).
- Fallback: Llama-2-Chat-13B (quantized variant for cost-sensitive routing).
- Notes: We'll route clinical-critical requests to the primary model; non-critical, high-throughput paths can use the smaller/fallback model. We can A/B traffic to measure quality delta.

Operational asks / owners:
- Camila (me): schedule kickoff + internal alignment; owner for commercial terms.
- Priyom (SE): lead model tuning, eval prompt design, instrumentation.
- Marcus (CS): own trial access, monitoring dashboards and runbook.
- Elena / Jared: confirm dataset samples and primary SME reviewers.

Attachments: poc_checklist_v1.pdf (POC tasks + contact matrix), eval_prompts_spanish_english.csv (seed prompts).

Next steps: Can you confirm the week-1 start window (Mon 2/23 or Tue 2/24)? Also please confirm whether you need an NDA addendum before we upload sample prompts.

Thanks — Camila

Thanks for the heads-up. Quick technical plan / notes below.

Model rationale and configuration:
- Primary model: Mistral-Instruct-2 (recommended) — strong instruction tuning and nominal multilingual behavior; baseline for quality tests.
- Fallback: Llama-2-Chat-13B quantized (8-bit QAT or 4-bit with Redwood-verified kernels) — used for lower-cost routing and throughput testing.
- Routing policy: prefix-sensitive routing in Redwood Console. Critical triage paths -> Mistral; bulk summarization/nonurgent routes -> fallback. We'll instrument A/B traffic (50/50) for first 200 sessions then pick winner.

Multilingual testing:
- We'll expand eval_prompts_spanish_english.csv to 150 pairs (English + Spanish equivalents) and add simple SMT back-translation checks to detect regressions.

Performance notes / infra estimate:
- Estimated 99p latency for 512 context / 64 tokens:
  * Mistral-Instruct-2 on a single A100: ~420–520 ms (depends on batch behavior).
  * Llama-2-Chat-13B quant (8-bit): ~220–300 ms.
- We'll enable prefix KV caching where repeated patient context exists — should cut per-token time for multi-turn flows by ~15–25%.

Instrumentation / dashboards:
- Marcus: we'll need these alerts: latency 95p/99p, token cost/billing by route, quality regression flagged by SME feedback form.

Next steps and owners (concrete):
1) Mon 2/23 — kickoff call (Camila to schedule).
2) Tue 2/24 — Redwood provisions trial infra & shares Console access (Marcus).
3) Wed 2/25 — early smoke tests + seed evaluation run (Priyom).
4) Fri 2/27 — joint quality review with Stellaris SMEs; collect annotations (Elena/Jared).

I'll prepare a short runbook (playbook) for the trial with tuning knobs and rollback steps and drop it in the Drive link by EOD Mon.
